title: sieve: RFC 5228 lexer (tokenizer)
description: Implement crates/sieve/src/lexer.rs. Tokenize RFC 5228 script text into a Token stream. Token enum: Identifier(String), TaggedArg(String), StringLiteral(String), Number(u64), LBracket, RBracket, LParen, RParen, Semicolon, Comma, LBrace, RBrace. Input: &str. Output: Vec<(Token, line, col)> or ParseError. Rules per RFC 5228 §8: hash comments (# to end of line), bracket comments (/* ... */), quoted strings (double-quote, backslash escapes: \ \" \r \n), multiline text literals (text: followed by newline, terminated by a line containing only a dot and newline), tagged arguments start with colon (:tag), identifiers are [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*, numbers are [0-9]+ with optional K/M/G suffix (converted to bytes: 1K=1024, 1M=1048576, 1G=1073741824). Whitespace (space, tab, CRLF, LF) is skipped. Track line and column for all tokens. Tests: tokenize every type of token, verify multiline literal, verify numeric suffixes, verify hash and bracket comments stripped.
